project: Sector Forge 1.0 — GitHub-ready package with favicon integration
scope: Validation of the exact project tree packaged for this release. The app code was preserved; changes are limited to favicon assets/references and release documentation/reporting.

svg_master.description: Square 64 × 64 SVG vector favicon with navy background, cyan orbital hexagon, and red central star.

github_pages_project_subpath_resolution.note: All favicon links resolve within a simulated repository project path; the index and all favicon assets returned HTTP 200.

zip_integrity.note: The packaged ZIP was tested, extracted, and its application audit and Chromium end-to-end suite were run from the extracted copy.

chromium_end_to_end.mode: Offline-inline mode (E2E_INLINE=1); three runs from the staging tree and one run from the exact downloadable ZIP after extraction
coverage: sector generation and SVG map bounds
linked systems, worlds, markets, trade routes, and corporate records
density presets and valid zero-system sectors
system survey rendering, overflow handling, and rerolls at multiple viewport widths
mobile touch behavior and normal page scrolling
map editor controls, explicit movement, and region editing
faction assets, diplomacy, influence, turns, and market repricing
empty-hex system creation and world/orbital/point-of-interest editing
chromium_end_to_end.environment_note: Direct localhost browser navigation was blocked by the execution environment, so the documented offline-inline test mode was used. Four randomized Chromium runs passed, including a final run from an extracted copy of the downloadable ZIP. This mode runs the same app HTML/CSS/JavaScript and local text data but does not exercise favicon rendering in a browser; favicon files, formats, dimensions, relative paths, and HTTP availability were tested separately.

deployment_note: No live GitHub Pages deployment was performed from this environment. After publishing, perform a final smoke check on the actual Pages URL, including the favicon in the browser tab.
